About the Position

This project focuses on supramolecular host engineering to enhance the capture and neutralisation of chemical warfare agents (CWAs).

OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship: Supramolecular Host Engineering for Enhanced CWA Capture & Neutralisation
HostUniversity of Birmingham
LocationBirmingham, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
StipendUKRI rate
Application DeadlineOpen (as of early August 2026)
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: Supramolecular Host Engineering for Enhanced CWA Capture & Neutralisation
  • Host Institution: University of Birmingham
  • Department: School of Chemistry
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Start Date: 2026/27
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: UKRI rate
  • Tuition Fees: Covered
  • Eligibility: Check School of Chemistry page
  • Application Deadline: Open (as of early August 2026)

Project Description

This project focuses on supramolecular host engineering to enhance the capture and neutralisation of chemical warfare agents (CWAs). The research is in defence/security-related chemistry.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/subjects/chemistry-courses/chemistry-phd

Source: birmingham.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Open (as of early August 2026) - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Birmingham

The University of Birmingham is a public research university in Birmingham, England, and a Russell Group member. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral study across engineering, medicine, science, business, humanities and social sciences. Research and teaching bring together different disciplines to investigate challenges affecting health, technology, communities and the environment.

Official website: https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Apply via the School of Chemistry PhD programme. Check the advert for supervisor contact details.

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.
